Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard Shri Abrar Ahmad, learned counsel holding brief of Shri Yakub Ansari, learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State; Ms. Gunjan Sharma, learned counsel appearing for Opposite Party No.2 and perused the record.

None has appeared for respondent no.4.
2.
The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report.
Subsequently, in the medical examination, the age of the victim was indicated as 18 year.s
The statement of the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C. was recorded wherein the victim stated that she had gone out of her own free will and both the applicant and the victim had married.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel appearing for Opposite Party No.2 argues that in the bail rejection order, based upon Class - V certificate, the age of the victim is recorded as less than 16 years.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the submissions made at the Bar, prima-facie, there is a credible dispute with regard to the age of the victim which has to be established based upon evidence at the time of trial; the statement of the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C. does not support the prosecution story coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedent and is in custody since 03.04.2023, as such, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Sahil Kuraishi be released on bail in FIR No.565 of 2022, under Section 363,
366, 376(3) IPC, Section 4(2) of POCSO Act & Section 3(2)(5KA), 3(2)(5) SC/ST Act, P.S. Kotwali Nagar Mahoba, District Mahoba on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 18.12.2023 nishant  Sahil Kuraishi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161604177/
